cdp.intro.zh: 先建草稿，再明确发布：上传只把分集放进草稿，不会让观众看到；只有你在“发布”里勾选的分集才会上线。
cdp.intro.en: Draft first, publish explicitly: uploading puts episodes in the draft and shows viewers nothing; only the episodes you tick under Publish go live.

cdp.loading.zh: 正在读取 CrazyDramas 上的状态…
cdp.loading.en: Reading where this series stands on CrazyDramas…

cdp.loadFailed.en: Could not read the upload state: {detail}

cdp.readOnly.role.zh: 只有此剧集的审批角色可以上传和发布到 CrazyDramas；其他角色可以查看上面的检查结果。
cdp.readOnly.role.en: Only the title's approver can upload and publish to CrazyDramas; everyone else can see the check above.

cdp.readOnly.preview.zh: 工作人员预览模式下不能在此上传或发布，请到工作人员页面操作。
cdp.readOnly.preview.en: Staff previewing the portal cannot upload or publish here; use the staff page.

cdp.readOnly.notAdmin.zh: 只有工作人员管理员可以上传和发布到 CrazyDramas。
cdp.readOnly.notAdmin.en: Only a staff administrator can upload and publish to CrazyDramas.

cdp.state.cms_managed.zh: 在 CMS 中创建 · 只读

cdp.writesOff.noReason.zh: Studio 没有说明缺少哪项设置。
cdp.writesOff.noReason.en: Studio did not say which setting is missing.

cdp.notLive.notUploaded.zh: crazydramas 上还没有这个 slug 的剧：带凭据的读取也返回 404（它能看到草稿）。
cdp.notLive.notUploaded.en: Nothing is on crazydramas under this slug yet: the authenticated read, which sees drafts, answers 404 too.

cdp.notLive.draft.zh: 这部剧在 crazydramas 上是草稿，观众还看不到。
cdp.notLive.draft.en: The series is a draft on crazydramas: viewers do not see it yet.

cdp.notLive.archived.zh: 这部剧在 crazydramas 上已归档，观众看不到。
cdp.notLive.archived.en: The series is archived on crazydramas: viewers do not see it.

cdp.notLinked.zh: 此剧集没有 crazydramas slug，无法创建系列。在影片的 cut/film-meta.json 里加上 crazydramas_slug，再到“导入影片”页点“更新”。
cdp.notLinked.en: This title has no crazydramas slug, so no series can be created. Add crazydramas_slug to the film's cut/film-meta.json, then Update it on Import films.

cdp.linkedElsewhere.zh: 这个 slug 在 crazydramas 上的剧已关联到另一部剧集，所以这里不显示它的任何内容，Studio 也不会向它发送任何东西。请工作人员处理。
cdp.linkedElsewhere.en: The series under this slug on crazydramas is linked to a different title, so nothing of it is shown here and Studio sends nothing to it. Staff can resolve it.

cdp.cms.note.zh: 这部剧是在 CMS 里创建的——请 Jayden 把它移交给 Studio（一行 SQL），之后才能在 Studio 里管理。Studio 不会修改它。
cdp.cms.note.en: Made in the CMS — ask Jayden to hand it over (one SQL line) to manage it from Studio. Studio never changes it.

cdp.cms.episodes.value.zh: CrazyDramas 上 {on} 集 · 已发布 {live} 集

cdp.series.liveEdit.zh: 查看或修改已上线系列的信息
cdp.series.liveEdit.en: See or change the live series' details

cdp.series.liveHint.zh: 这部剧已上线：保存修改会改动观众看到的内容，CrazyDramas 可能要求先确认。
cdp.series.liveHint.en: This series is live: saving changes what viewers see, and CrazyDramas may refuse it until that is confirmed.

cdp.form.title.hint.zh: 观众在 crazydramas.com 上看到的剧名。与已有的剧同名会被拒绝。
cdp.form.title.hint.en: The title viewers see on crazydramas.com. A title another series already has is refused.

cdp.form.genre.hint.zh: 用逗号分隔，例如 Romance, Billionaire。
cdp.form.genre.hint.en: Separated by commas, e.g. Romance, Billionaire.

cdp.form.free.hint.zh: 第 1 集到第 N 集免费，其余付费。默认 5。
cdp.form.free.hint.en: Episodes 1 to N are free, the rest paid. Default 5.

cdp.form.free.bad.zh: 免费分集数必须是 0 到 500 之间的整数。
cdp.form.free.bad.en: Free episodes must be a whole number from 0 to 500.

cdp.form.price.bad.zh: 价格要写成美元金额，例如 9.99。
cdp.form.price.bad.en: Write the price as dollars, for example 9.99.

cdp.form.iap.hint.zh: 格式为 cd.series.<短名>，最多 40 个字符，只能用小写字母、数字、_ 和 .。它要在 App Store Connect、Play Console 和 RevenueCat 里手动创建，一旦商店里有了就不能再改。
cdp.form.iap.hint.en: cd.series.<short_name>, at most 40 characters of lowercase letters, digits, _ and . — created by hand in App Store Connect, Play Console and RevenueCat, and never changeable once a store has it.

cdp.form.iap.bad.zh: 格式不对：最多 40 个字符，只能用小写字母、数字、_ 和 .，并以字母或数字开头。
cdp.form.iap.bad.en: Not the right form: at most 40 characters of lowercase letters, digits, _ and ., starting with a letter or digit.

cdp.form.poster.hint.zh: 竖版 3:4 的 JPG，放在永久公开的 https 地址上。发送前 Studio 会先确认它返回 200 且是图片。
cdp.form.poster.hint.en: A 3:4 portrait JPG at a permanent public https address. Studio checks it answers 200 with an image before sending it.

cdp.form.poster.noAnswer.en: the poster address did not answer

cdp.form.poster.notSent.zh: 海报地址没有通过检查，所以没有发送：{reason}
cdp.form.poster.notSent.en: The poster address did not pass the check, so nothing was sent: {reason}

cdp.form.cover.zh: Studio 里的封面。把它发给 Jayden，放到 /posters/{slug}.jpg。
cdp.form.cover.en: Studio's cover. Send it to Jayden for /posters/{slug}.jpg.

cdp.form.cover.none.zh: 此剧集在 Studio 里没有封面。
cdp.form.cover.none.en: This title has no cover in Studio.

cdp.form.create.hint.zh: 系列以草稿创建，观众看不到。
cdp.form.create.hint.en: The series is created as a draft; viewers see nothing.

cdp.upload.hint.zh: Studio 在后台逐集上传本地文件，一次一集；可以离开此页面。上传不会发布任何分集。
cdp.upload.hint.en: Studio sends each episode's local file in the background, one at a time; you can leave this page. Uploading publishes nothing.

cdp.upload.needSeries.zh: 先创建草稿系列，再上传分集。
cdp.upload.needSeries.en: Create the draft series first, then upload episodes.

cdp.upload.all.en: Upload all episodes not on CrazyDramas ({n})

cdp.upload.running.zh: 正在处理 {n} 集，此列表每 2 秒刷新一次。
cdp.upload.running.en: {n} episodes on their way; this list refreshes every 2 seconds.

cdp.upload.runningOne.zh: 正在处理 1 集，此列表每 2 秒刷新一次。
cdp.upload.runningOne.en: 1 episode on its way; this list refreshes every 2 seconds.

cdp.upload.none.en: This title has no episodes yet.

cdp.stage.processing.hint.zh: Mux 已收到文件，正在转码。
cdp.stage.processing.hint.en: Mux has the file and is encoding it.

cdp.stage.verified.hint.zh: 时长和文件指纹都对得上，可以发布。
cdp.stage.verified.hint.en: Length and file fingerprint match; ready to publish.

cdp.row.replace.aria.zh: 用 Studio 的文件替换第 {n} 集

cdp.publish.state.zh: 可发布 {ready} 集 · 已发布 {live} 集。

cdp.publish.needSeries.zh: 创建草稿系列并上传分集之后才能发布。
cdp.publish.needSeries.en: Publishing opens once the draft series exists and episodes are uploaded.

cdp.publish.paywallNote.zh: 付费墙修复上线之前，发布付费分集需要额外确认。
cdp.publish.paywallNote.en: Until the paywall fix is live, publishing a paid episode needs its own confirm.

cdp.publish.lede.zh: 只有下面勾选的分集会上线，其他一律不发布。
cdp.publish.lede.en: Only the episodes ticked below go live. Nothing else is published.

cdp.publish.pick.zh: 已核对、尚未发布的分集

cdp.publish.noneReady.zh: 没有已核对、尚未发布的分集。
cdp.publish.noneReady.en: No verified episode is waiting to be published.

cdp.publish.splitValue.zh: 免费 {free} 集 · 付费 {paid} 集

cdp.publish.withSeries.zh: 同时让系列上线（现在是草稿）
cdp.publish.withSeries.en: Also publish the series (it is a draft now)

cdp.publish.needEpisode.zh: 系列上线时至少要有一集已发布。
cdp.publish.needEpisode.en: A series cannot go live with no published episode.

cdp.publish.paidWarn.zh: 付费墙修复在 crazydramas 上线之前，付费分集（第 {list} 集）可以被免费观看。
cdp.publish.paidWarn.en: Paid episodes can be streamed free until the paywall fix is live on crazydramas (episodes {list}).

cdp.publish.paidConfirm.zh: 我明白，仍然发布这些付费分集
cdp.publish.paidConfirm.en: I understand; publish the paid episodes anyway

cdp.publish.paywallLive.zh: 付费墙修复已上线（CRAZYDRAMAS_PAYWALL_LIVE=1），付费分集按付费提供。
cdp.publish.paywallLive.en: The paywall fix is live (CRAZYDRAMAS_PAYWALL_LIVE=1); paid episodes are sold as paid.

cdp.publish.notDone.zh: 未发布：第 {list} 集（发布时它们已不再就绪），就绪后再发布。
cdp.publish.notDone.en: Not published: episodes {list} (they stopped being ready); publish them again once ready.

cdp.unpublish.lede.zh: 勾选的分集会立即对观众隐藏；文件保留，之后可以再发布。
cdp.unpublish.lede.en: The ticked episodes are hidden from viewers at once; the files stay and can be published again.

cdp.unpublish.withSeries.en: Also set the series back to draft

cdp.unpublish.warn.zh: 观众将立即看不到第 {list} 集。

cdp.unpublish.warnNone.en: Tick the episodes to take down.

cdp.unpublish.seriesDraft.en: The series is a draft again.

cdp.replace.lede.zh: 用 Studio 现在的文件（重新剪辑过）替换 CrazyDramas 上的这一集。发送之前请先知道：
cdp.replace.lede.en: Send Studio's current file (a re-cut) over the episode on CrazyDramas. Before you do:

cdp.replace.impact.old.zh: 新文件就绪之前，观众仍然看到旧的剪辑。
cdp.replace.impact.old.en: Viewers keep seeing the old cut until the new file is ready.

cdp.replace.impact.oldDraft.zh: 新文件就绪之前，这一集仍然是旧的剪辑。
cdp.replace.impact.oldDraft.en: The episode keeps the old cut until the new file is ready.

cdp.replace.impact.unchecked.zh: CrazyDramas 一处理好新文件，观众就会看到新的剪辑，那时 Studio 还没核对它；如果核对没通过，请撤下这一集。
cdp.replace.impact.unchecked.en: Viewers see the new cut as soon as crazydramas has it ready, before Studio checks it; if the check fails, unpublish the episode.

cdp.replace.impact.progress.zh: 观众的观看进度仍按旧剪辑的时间点记录。
cdp.replace.impact.progress.en: Viewers' watch positions then refer to the old timing.

cdp.replace.impact.kept.zh: 旧文件保留在 Mux 上，不会删除（Mux 按存储计费）。
cdp.replace.impact.kept.en: The old file is kept on Mux, never deleted (Mux bills its storage).
